d: Pakistan A stormed into the final of the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 with a convincing 5-wicket victory over Bangladesh A in the second semi-final. Chasing 233, Pakistan A reached the target in just 45.2 overs, finishing at 233/5 with 28 balls to spare. Abdul Samad led the charge with a quickfire 44 off 33 deliveries, guiding his side to a comfortable win.
